test_item:
Verification of Project-Specific Critical Extension
(extension value is the project identifier; certificate is accepted)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk is installed
3. A leaf certificate with the NR1L project-specific critical extension is available
input: Leaf certificate carrying CertificatePolicies marked critical with OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.57872.<…>
proc:
1. Read the certificate extensions on the host
$ openssl x509 -in leaf.crt -text
2. Run the OpenSSL chain verification of the leaf certificate on the host
$ openssl verify -verbose -CAfile RootCert.pem -untrusted L1.pem -untrusted L2.pem -untrusted L3.pem SAMcert.pem
3. Confirm the Cert Provider accepts the certificate
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test.CertProviderServiceManagerTest#fotaMcpuCertTestNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.melcocertprovider.libcertproviderservice.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
er:
1. The openssl output shows `X509v3 Certificate Policies: critical` and `Policy: 1.3.6.1.4.1.57872.<…>`
2. The openssl command prints `SAMcert.pem: OK` on stdout
3. The instrumentation runner reports `OK (1 test)` for fotaMcpuCertTestNormalFlow
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: CertProfile r36 (CertificatePolicies critical, OID prefix verbatim); 037 SWE1-CertProvider-011 Verification Criteria
Polarion: NRL-349394
OID suffix kept as `<…>` placeholder — CertProfile does not give the value (IN §8.4.1)
